regimen_profiles.clinical_summary: First-line treatment after surgery for stage III epithelial ovarian, fallopian tube or primary peritoneal cancer with at least 1 cm residual disease, or stage IV disease.
regimen_profiles.component_rationale: Paclitaxel — It disrupts cell division. Hair follicles, blood cells and nerves can also be affected. Carboplatin — It damages DNA in dividing cells. Kidney function helps determine the prescribed amount. Bevacizumab — It reduces signals that help tumours form blood vessels. This can also affect blood pressure, kidneys and wound healing.
regimen_profiles.schedule_context: Paclitaxel, carboplatin and bevacizumab 7.5 mg/kg every 21 days for up to six cycles. Omit bevacizumab in cycle 1 if starting within four weeks of surgery. Bevacizumab 7.5 mg/kg alone every 21 days. Up to 18 bevacizumab doses in total, counting combination doses.
key_points: Day 1 every 21 days, then bevacizumab alone.
Call the oncology unit now for fever, chills, severe abdominal pain, unexpected bleeding or new breathlessness.
regimen_profiles.review_status: Feasibility build. Clinical, pharmacy and patient review pending.
